name: Camera Rig
description: A fixed game camera — top-down, isometric or following the player — that takes over while a player is inside its area and frames the whole area on any screen, phones included.

changelog.notes: Initial release: a top-down, isometric or follow camera that takes over while a player is inside its area (or all the time), fits the whole area on desktop and phone screens, and hands the default camera back on the way out.
